fusions.name: Shrike's Larder
fusions.desc: Impales the target for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stoop From the Sun
fusions.desc: Dives you onto a target up to 8 tiles away and stabs for 14 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: High Perch
fusions.desc: Glides you 3 tiles from where you stood, and increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Speed
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
